message.reasoning_content: We have stuffed animals: 3 giraffes, 5 koalas, 2 zebras, 4 frogs. Total =3+5+2+4=14. Let x goats. Total becomes 14+x. Need goats to be 30% of total: x =0.3*(14+x). Solve: x = 4.2 +0.3x => x-0.3x=4.2 =>0.7x=4.2 => x=6. So need 6 goats.
